# TV Guide

> > Comprehensive TV listings, streaming service guides, live sports schedules, and entertainment news covering Netflix, Prime Video, Hulu, HBO Max, Peacock, Paramount+, and other major platforms.

TV Guide provides local and national television schedules, streaming recommendations across major services, live sports programming information, and entertainment news. The site serves as a central resource for discovering what to watch across traditional broadcast, cable, satellite, and streaming platforms.

## Key Topics

- TV listings and schedules
- Streaming services (Netflix, Prime Video, Hulu, HBO Max, Peacock, Paramount+, Tubi)
- Live sports broadcasts (MLB, NBA, NHL)
- Local TV schedules by ZIP code
- Entertainment and celebrity news
- Show and movie recommendations
- Broadcast schedules
- Streaming catalog browsing
- Sports game times and listings
- Antenna, cable, and satellite TV guides

## Core TV Listings & Schedules

- [TV Guide, TV Listings, Streaming Services, Entertainment News and Celebrity News - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com): Homepage with streaming recommendations, TV reviews, and entertainment news
- [TV Guide, TV Listings, Online Videos, Entertainment News and Celebrity News - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/Listings): TV schedule and listings for shows, movies, and programs across providers

## Streaming Service Guides

- [What to Watch on Netflix - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/streaming/netflix): Netflix catalog browser with 6,443 movies and TV shows to discover

## Live Sports Schedules

- [Live Sports On TV Today - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/sports/live-today): Today's live sports schedule: MLB, NBA, NHL, college basketball & more
